import os
import sys
import unittest

# Make the worktree root importable regardless of the current working
# directory so that `dedupe` (which lives at the root) can be imported.
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from dedupe import dedupe  # noqa: E402


class TestDedupePreservesFirstOccurrenceOrder(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_removes_duplicates_in_input_order(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["b", "a", "b", "c", "a"]), ["b", "a", "c"])

    def test_first_occurrence_is_kept(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["x", "y", "x"]), ["x", "y"])

    def test_all_unique_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["q", "r", "s"]), ["q", "r", "s"])

    def test_single_element(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["only"]), ["only"])

    def test_repeated_single_element(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe(["z", "z", "z", "z"]), ["z"])


class TestDedupeEmptyInput(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_list_returns_empty_list(self):
        self.assertEqual(dedupe([]), [])

    def test_empty_list_is_not_none(self):
        self.assertIsNotNone(dedupe([]))

    def test_result_is_a_list(self):
        self.assertIsInstance(dedupe([]), list)


class TestDedupeElementValidation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_non_str_element_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(["ok", 1, "ok"])

    def test_int_only_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe([1, 2, 3])

    def test_none_element_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(["a", None])

    def test_fresh_bytes_element_raises_value_error(self):
        # bytes is not a str; the `isinstance(x, str)` check must reject it.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe([b"a", "a"])

    def test_error_happens_before_any_return(self):
        # A non-str among otherwise-valid items must still raise.
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(["a", "b", 3, "a"])


class TestDedupeInputContainerValidation(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_string_not_a_list_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe("abc")

    def test_tuple_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(("a", "b"))

    def test_none_raises_value_error(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe(None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    """Remove duplicates from a list of str, preserving FIRST-occurrence order."""
    if not isinstance(items, list):
